      <title>Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes to staff: ‘I made some terrible mistakes’</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/jensen-huang-nvidia-apologizes-staff</link>
      <description><p>Huang acknowledges he violated code of conduct by having affairs, but denied Trump was instrumental in his return</p><p>Jensen Huang apologized to staff on Tuesday for the tumult he’s caused at Nvidia. The company’s CEO acknowledged he violated the code of conduct for having extramarital affairs, but pushed back on the reports that Donald Trump was instrumental in his reinstatement as chief executive.</p><p>“I made some terrible mistakes,” he said, according to a livestream <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/technology/jensen-huang-apology-nvidia-ceo.html">reviewed by the New York Times</a>. “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and, of course, I hurt all of you.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/24/jensen-huang-nvidia-apologizes-staff">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/education/2026/nov/24/school-bus-driver-decline-budget</link>
      <description><p>Total number of drivers dropped 5% over the last year and fell 15% compared with 2019 levels, new report finds</p><p>The number of school bus drivers in the US has dropped 5% over the last year as drivers continue to experience low pay, poor working conditions and school budget shortfalls, according to a new report.</p><p>The total number of school bus drivers is down 15%, or nearly 34,000 drivers, compared with 2019 levels, according to an new <a href="https://www.epi.org/blog/the-school-bus-driver-shortage-is-worsening-as-wages-fall-once-again/#_ref2">analysis</a> from the Economic Policy Institute.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/education/2026/nov/24/school-bus-driver-decline-budget">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>John Kennedy looks to Trump leaders as he asks how China evidently bypassed export controls for Nvidia’s top AI chips</p><p>Invoking Greek mythology, the US senator John Kennedy has characterized former <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/nvidia">Nvidia</a> chief executive officer <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/jensen-huang">Jensen Huang</a>’s reported affair with a suspected Chinese spy as “the <a href="https://x.com/atrupar/status/2124514031209980207?a=ArDF3m1PBQGZjNDPrME&amp;s=20">most expensive</a> sex since Helen of Troy”.</p><p>The Louisiana Republican’s allusion to the legendary figure whose desirability was such that it caused the mythic Trojan war came during an interview on NBC’s Meet the Press on Sunday.
